entities.summary: Salar Aghili, known by his full name Mir Salar Moslemi Aghili, is a classical and Persian traditional singer. His spouse, Harir Shariat–Zadeh is a Persian musician who plays piano and daf. Salar Aghili was a composers & musicians from Tehran (b. 1977-12-02, Tehran). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
